title: Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Pure \& Cure Technology (PNC) is a premium industrial platform specializing in water and wastewater treatment components and solutions. The company partners with leading global manufacturers to offer a wide range of products, including pumps, membranes, membrane housings, chemicals, dosing pumps, ion exchange resins, drives, tanks, pipes, fittings, valves, and digital instrumentation. PNC serves quality\-conscious organizations across India through a strong sales and service network. The team is supported by experienced engineers and R\&D experts who provide technical guidance, training, seminars, and symposiums on water and wastewater treatment. PNC focuses on long\-term client relationships through committed service, reliable technical support, and consistently high product standards.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Executive role based in Uppal. The Sales Executive will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, generating leads, and managing the sales cycle for water and wastewater treatment components and solutions. Day\-to\-day tasks include meeting with prospective and existing customers, presenting product offerings, preparing quotations, negotiating terms, and closing deals in line with company targets. The role involves coordinating with technical and service teams to understand client requirements, provide accurate product recommendations, and ensure timely after\-sales support. The Sales Executive will also maintain accurate sales records, participate in product training sessions, and represent PNC at customer meetings, trainings, and industry events as required.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, customer relationship management, and negotiation.
* Knowledge of industrial water and wastewater treatment products or related engineering solutions, with the ability to understand technical specifications.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex solutions in a clear and simple manner.
* Ability to work on\-site, manage field visits, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as engineering, service, and R\&D.
* Prior experience in industrial or technical sales is preferred; experience in the water treatment sector is an advantage.
* Relevant qualification in Engineering, Science, Business, or a related field is beneficial.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency in basic office and CRM software.
* Willingness to travel within the region and attend trainings, seminars, and customer events as required.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**About Joify** 




 Joify is a new\-age ice cream brand built on our family's four decades of expertise in ice cream manufacturing. We make real Ice Cream (not frozen dessert), formulated with 11% milk fat to deliver superior richness and creaminess. We’re on a mission to build a strong regional FMCG brand across South India, starting with Andhra Pradesh \& Telangana.
 



  





 Instagram: @joifyicecreams
 



  





 We’re looking for a
 **high\-energy, on\-ground sales executive** 
 who can help us grow our retail and distribution network.
 



  





**Job Details** 




 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 4 years in Sales (Required)
 



 Work Mode: On\-ground / In\-person
 



 Location: Telangana
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 This is a field sales role focused on expanding Joify’s presence across your assigned territory by onboarding retailers, managing relationships, and driving sales.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Lead Generation \& Onboarding** 
 : Identify new sales opportunities and onboard retailers, distributors, and dealers
* **Relationship Management:** 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with existing retailers and distributors
* **Target Achievement:** 
 Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets and KPIs
* **Distribution \& Merchandising:** 
 Ensure proper product placement, freezer stocking, and inventory management
* **Market Analysis:** 
 Monitor competitor activity and share market insights
* **Field Visits:** 
 Conduct regular field visits within your assigned territory



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  




* Experience: 4\+ years in FMCG, beverage, or food industry sales, preferably in cold\-chain products.
* Skills: Strong negotiation, communication, and B2B/B2C sales skills
* Logistics: Must have a vehicle and valid driving license for field sales.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing/Business preferred.
* Software: Proficiency in MS Office and basic CRM softwares.
* Comfortable with on\-ground, field\-based work



  





**Why Join Joify?** 




  




* Health insurance, Food allowance, Provident fund, Annual bonus
* Be part of a fast\-growing FMCG brand
* High ownership and growth opportunities
* Work directly with leadership
* Build a strong career in sales and distribution

title: Business Development Analyst
description:
**About Paninian :** 
 https://www.svayatt.co.in
 



  
 



**What you'll do**

title: Sales Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Sales Manager – Zoho Solutions to lead our Zoho sales initiatives. The role requires deep expertise in Zoho ecosystem sales, strong pipeline management, CXO\-level engagement, and the ability to drive structured revenue growth through CRM\-driven sales processes.
   




 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in SaaS solution selling, account expansion, proposal preparation, and digital transformation consulting across multiple Zoho applications.
   

  

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Sales Strategy \& Revenue Growth
   

  

  

* Develop and execute sales strategies to drive Zoho solution revenue
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets
* Expand business through new logo acquisition and key account growth
* Drive up selling and cross\-selling across the Zoho ecosystem


 Lead \& Pipeline Management
   

  

  

* Oversee structured lead qualification using BANT framework
* Ensure proper pipeline creation, deal staging, and forecasting accuracy
* Maintain strong conversion ratios across the sales funnel
* Prevent lead leakage through disciplined CRM management


 Proposal Development \& Commercial Structuring
   

  

  

* Prepare detailed and customized business proposals and commercial quotes
* Align solutions with client requirements and scope of work
* Collaborate with Pre\-Sales and Delivery teams for technical and functional inputs
* Present proposals confidently to decision\-makers and stakeholders
* Negotiate commercials and close deals effectively


 Enterprise \& CXO Engagement
   

  

  

* Engage with CXOs, IT Heads, CFOs, CHROs, and decision\-makers
* Identify operational gaps and position Zoho as a strategic solution
* Lead high\-value enterprise discussions and negotiations


 Deal Closure \& Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

  

* Manage the complete sales lifecycle from prospecting to closure
* Coordinate with Pre\-Sales, Delivery, Finance, and Support teams
* Ensure seamless handover post\-closure for successful implementation


 Customer Retention \& Account Growth
   

  

  

* Drive long\-term customer relationships and key account retention
* Support renewals, expansions, and digital transformation initiatives
* Identify new opportunities within existing customer base


 CRM Discipline \& Reporting
   

  

  

* Ensure accurate CRM updates and opportunity tracking
* Maintain data hygiene across leads, deals, and accounts
* Provide regular sales forecasts, reports, and pipeline insights
* Adhere to structured sales workflows and organizational processes
* 


 Requirements
   

  

* 6–10 years of experience in B2B SaaS / Zoho solution sales
* Strong understanding of Zoho ecosystem (CRM, Books, People, Desk, Creator, Projects, etc.)
* Proven track record of revenue growth and key account retention
* Strong experience in proposal creation, commercial structuring, and negotiation
* Experience in enterprise solution selling and digital transformation consulting
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* High ownership mindset with structured, process\-driven approach

title: Tele Caller
description:
**Company Description** 
 Luminara Legacy Pvt. Ltd. specializes in high\-quality seeds, pesticides, micro\-nutrients, and sustainable farming solutions. The company is dedicated to empowering farmers through reliable products and practical support that enhance crop yield and resilience. By focusing on agricultural innovation, Luminara Legacy aims to improve productivity and long\-term soil health. Team members contribute to a mission that supports rural communities and a more prosperous, sustainable agricultural future for all.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Tele Caller role based in Kompally. The Tele Caller will make outbound calls to farmers, distributors, and retail partners to share product information, explain benefits, and respond to basic queries about seeds, pesticides, and micro\-nutrients. The role involves following call scripts, maintaining accurate records of conversations in the system, and updating customer details after each interaction. The Tele Caller will also support lead generation, schedule follow\-up calls or visits for the sales team, and provide feedback on customer needs and market trends. Collaboration with sales, marketing, and customer support teams is expected to ensure consistent communication and a positive customer experience.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong verbal communication skills in a professional phone environment, with clear and respectful customer interaction.
* Basic knowledge or interest in agriculture, seeds, pesticides, and micro\-nutrients, or willingness to learn quickly.
* Ability to maintain accurate call logs, update customer databases, and follow structured call scripts or guidelines.
* Sales or customer service aptitude, including handling objections, identifying opportunities, and building rapport over the phone.
* Comfort working with basic computer tools and CRM or call\-tracking software.
* Ability to work on\-site in
 
 Kompally
 
 , manage time effectively, and meet daily or weekly call and follow\-up targets.
* Prior experience in telecalling, customer support, or inside sales is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Minimum high school diploma or equivalent; additional education in agriculture, business, or a related field is a plus.
